'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Winston Plunkett DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Winston Plunkett]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' HD(V)
* '''Username:''' WinstonP
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
